notes: Reviewed 2026-11-15: Sakai stx- is the standard lab strain; wild_type (user decision) | Methanol vehicle = control. Lambda-5b is a synthetic antimicrobial metallo-compound (flexicate), labelled abx_other; mechanism not given. Samples 40 min after treatment of mid-exponential cells keep mid_exponential.

growth_phase.q: E. coli Sakai O157:H7 stx- grown to mid-exponential was treated with either methanol (control) or 0.5 µg/ml of Λ-5b

culture_mode.q: The bacteria were grown in cation-adjusted Mueller-Hinton broth at 37 ˚C, shaking

inducer_added.q: treated with either methanol (control) or 0.5 µg/ml of Λ-5b (dissolved in methanol)

transcription_arrested.q: treated with either methanol (control) or 0.5 µg/ml of Λ-5b (dissolved in methanol)

mixed_organism.q: treated with either methanol (control) or 0.5 µg/ml of Λ-5b (dissolved in methanol)

rrna_removal.q: Ribosomal RNA was depleted using the Ribo-Zero bacterial rRNA removal kit (Illumina).

treatment.q: The synthetic flexicate compound Λ-5b shows potent antimicrobial activity against E. coli.

exposure.q: The cultures were incubated for a further 40 min
